notes.title: The Early Access Version Is Out Now

The Early Access version of Ancient Warfare: The Han Dynasty, an indie wargame developed by Bamboo Games and published by Cube Game, is available now on Steam with a 10% discount lasting for one week.

This game demonstrates how Expeditionary Army of Han expelled invaders of Xiongnu and recovered Western Regions. Many heroes emerged around that time and they deserve to be honored. 

The development team is composed of only 5 people. They built up this game from zero and put much effort into it. They’ll keep polishing this game according to players’ feedback until it’s out of Early Access.

There were many dynasties in ancient China. The Han Dynasty won’t be the only title of Ancient Warfare series. More dynasties will be presented in the future. Stay tuned!
